verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe in-PR chat where developers can ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, challenge recommendations and explore alternatives (docs-6, docs-52). A documented @coderabbitai command set covers reviews, pausing, resolving and summaries (docs-15, docs-50, docs-71), and chat can draw on MCP-sourced context and feed learnings into future reviews (docs-12, docs-51). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that in-thread answers are accurate and context-aware; the only community mention (comm-4) is secondhand and hedged ('supposedly').
